comments.note: The DatabaseBootstrapperTests.cs had two hardcoded integer literals (37 and 38) alongside a reference-based assertion using DatabaseBootstrapper.ExpectedRevision. The mixed approach (some tests use the constant, others use integer literals) creates a maintenance hazard: only the reference-based assertion catches drift automatically. Consider replacing all hardcoded revision integers in the test file with DatabaseBootstrapper.ExpectedRevision ± offset arithmetic.
